changelog: Version 1.0.1 - Version 1.0.2 had bugs, reverted to 1.0.1 while investigation continues

changes: Enabled Spanish, Italian, French, and Portuguese language support (previously marked "Soon"), and added German and Russian — 7 languages total.

Fixed hundreds of missing or incomplete translations across every non-English language, including navigation, Game Booster, Server Booster, Startup Boost, Debloat, and the Priorities Tuner reference tables.
Added automatic detection of your Windows display language on first launch.
Added a restart-required notification bar after applying tweaks, with a one-click Restart button.
Added real Discord server-membership verification for Server Booster, with a direct Join Discord button.
Fixed the desktop shortcut prompt to reappear if the shortcut goes missing, and it now also adds a Start Menu entry.
